mentions.name: Underscore
mentions.description: On-demand, procedural audio programs built with LLMs, designed to be embeddable in software such as games and health/wellness apps.
mentions.audience: Developers who might embed the audio programs in software such as games and health/wellness apps.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Underscore: https://underscore.audio/

On-demand, procedural audio programs (w/LLMs). I’m working to make these embeddable in software such as games and health/wellness apps.

Would love to hear how developers might use it.
